claims.assertion: Mari Swa describes human-Lyrians across space as linked by a species-wide collective unconscious that shares thoughts and emotions telepathically regardless of distance, and says similar perceptions and ideas make them one people.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She presents this as a metaphysical account of shared human identity.

claims.assertion: Mari Swa says souls reincarnate on different planets and retain past-life experiences as memories shaping personality despite conscious forgetting; she says starseeds return after death to vibrationally compatible worlds.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She frames these as metaphysical beliefs about souls and postmortem destinations.

review_flags: The source presents metaphysical claims about interstellar humanity, telepathy, reincarnation, and vibrational return.
coverage_gaps: The video also describes human-Lyrian cultural commonalities, starseed identity, and historical mixing among spacefaring groups.
